_basis: synthetic executable transition vectors; base=control-request-valid.json; each case is a reducer/transport expectation, not a schema instance

cases.given: grant revoked after PACKAGE_ACCEPTED before sidecar validates
cases.expect: Receipt rejected or late_after_revoke; never qualified; bytes retained audit-only

cases.given: Session CANCELLED via consent disarm while request QUEUED
cases.expect: request CANCELLED; no attempt reservation allowed

cases.given: cancel CAS wins before shutter latch
shutter latch wins before cancel CAS
cases.expect: image preserved, Receipt late_after_cancel, does not fulfill
no shutter; late bytes if any = late_after_expire

cases.given: revision 1 bytes arrive after revision 2 created

cases.expect: original response replayed; no duplicate request/attempt
snapshot_required; phone fetches snapshot before re-arming; cursor not advanced past gap
SPATIAL_PENDING/package_only pending; no qualified until package validates; pending expires with request TTL then rejected

cases.given: ZIP validates, sidecar fails semantic check
cases.expect: PACKAGE_ACCEPTED/SPATIAL_PENDING then REJECTED on failed sidecar; repair only via new sidecar revision with supersedes

cases.given: same package hash + same guided binding retried after response loss
cases.expect: duplicate collapsed; one Receipt; no duplicate shutter

cases.given: second request_view while first active on same source
cases.expect: queued (max 20) not active; one active request/source enforced

cases.given: max_images=20, every shutter incl retake/failed counts
cases.expect: 21st reservation denied; CAD set spanning grants must reference multiple sessions/grants explicitly
